import json,time,traceback
from pathlib import Path
from rhombus.domain.archetypes import ARCHETYPES,build_archetype_a3
from rhombus.transport.static_assessment import assess_coordination_pairwise_transport
from rhombus.qualification.electronic_insulation import assess_electronic_insulation
from rhombus.qualification.electrochemical_window import assess_electrochemical_window
from rhombus.atomistics.phase_stability_p1 import assess_phase_stability
from rhombus.pipeline.funnel import RhombusDiscoveryFunnel
rows=[]
for name in ARCHETYPES:
 t=time.monotonic();row={'name':name}
 try:
  info=build_archetype_a3(name,allow_idealized_completion=True);s=info.pop('structure');row.update(info);row['structure']=s.as_dict()
  c={'composition':s.composition.element_composition.as_dict()}
  row['hull']=assess_phase_stability(c,reference_revision='A2')
  row['esw']=assess_electrochemical_window(c,reference_revision='A2',include_intrinsic=True,dilute_parent_limit=True)
  row['electronic']=assess_electronic_insulation(s)
  row['transport']=assess_coordination_pairwise_transport(s,defect=info['defect'])
  row['static']=RhombusDiscoveryFunnel._static_verdict({'P0':row['electronic'],'P0_5':row['transport'],'P1':row['hull']})
  row['status']='COMPUTED_UNQUALIFIED';r=row['transport']
  print(name,round(r['charge_metadata']['q_Li'],4),round(r['host_channel_barrier_3d_ev'],4),round(r['spectator_caged_hop_barrier_ev'],4),round(r['effective_activation_barrier_ev'],4),r['mep']['converged'],row['static'],flush=True)
 except Exception as error:
  row.update(status='FAILED',error=repr(error),traceback=traceback.format_exc());print(name,'FAILED',repr(error),flush=True)
 row['elapsed_seconds']=time.monotonic()-t;rows.append(row)
 Path('/tmp/rhombus-coord-benchmark.json').write_text(json.dumps(rows,sort_keys=True,indent=2,allow_nan=False)+'\n')

import json,numpy as np
from pathlib import Path
from pymatgen.core import Structure
from rhombus.transport.bvse_parameters import build_charge_scaled_evaluator,coordination_summary
from rhombus.transport.bvse_percolation import SpectatorSiteEnergyEvaluator,percolation_thresholds
from rhombus.transport.static_assessment import assess_host_frenkel_proxy
rows=json.loads(Path('/tmp/rhombus-coord-benchmark.json').read_text())
for row in rows:
 if row['status']=='FAILED':
  s=Structure.from_dict(row['structure']);coord=coordination_summary(s);host=build_charge_scaled_evaluator(s,coordination=coord['effective']);field=host.grid(.22,min_dimension=8,max_dimension=64)
  p=percolation_thresholds(field);f=assess_host_frenkel_proxy(s,host,field,p)
  row['partial']={'charge_metadata':host.charge_metadata,'coordination_summary':coord,'host_channel_barrier_3d_ev':p['barriers_eV']['3D'],'frenkel':f,'grid_shape':list(field.shape)}
  print(row['name'],'PARTIAL',coord['effective'],p['barriers_eV']['3D'],f['site_energy_difference_eV'],flush=True);continue
 r=row['transport'];s=Structure.from_dict(r.get('expanded_probe_structure',row['structure']));probe=s.copy()
 if r['frenkel']['required']:probe.remove_sites([next(i for i,a in enumerate(probe) if a.specie.symbol=='Li')])
 initial=np.array(r['mep']['endpoint_relaxations'][0]['nominal_position_A'])
 active=min((i for i,a in enumerate(probe) if a.specie.symbol=='Li'),key=lambda i:np.linalg.norm(probe[i].coords-initial))
 assert np.linalg.norm(probe[active].coords-initial)<1e-7
 host=build_charge_scaled_evaluator(probe,charge_reference=s,coordination=r['coordination_summary']['effective'])
 e=SpectatorSiteEnergyEvaluator(probe,active,host,periodic_cutoff_A=8.,screening_A=.74*1.52,charge_product=r['charge_metadata']['q_Li']**2*r['charge_metadata']['pair_scale'])
 energies,forces=e(r['mep']['positions_A']);error=float(np.max(np.abs(energies-r['mep']['energies_eV'])))
 assert error<1e-9
 a,b=r['host_channel_barrier_3d_ev'],r['spectator_caged_hop_barrier_ev'];x=r['vacancy_fraction']
 assert abs(r['effective_activation_barrier_ev']-(max(a,b) if x>0 else a+b))<1e-10
 row['verification']={'band_energy_max_error_eV':error,'endpoint_force_norm_eV_A':np.linalg.norm(forces[[0,-1]],axis=1).tolist(),'active_index':active}
Path('/tmp/rhombus-coord-verified.json').write_text(json.dumps(rows,sort_keys=True,indent=2,allow_nan=False)+'\n')
print('VERIFIED',sum(x['status']=='COMPUTED_UNQUALIFIED' for x in rows),'FAILED',sum(x['status']=='FAILED' for x in rows),flush=True)
